text: {"lessons":["Judge trades by the business and forward prospects, not by whether a position is below my average cost; selling at a loss is not itself a mistake.","Avoid reactive turnover: repeated selling and buying across stocks can lock in losses and make it harder to outperform the market.","Keep enough cash and size positions prudently; recent gains or price moves alone are not a reason to add, and I should act only when the evidence supports it."]}
